escapeEvidence.scope: Isolated unsaved creation; default and explicitly accepted nondefault draft State. The saved-company case is an original Bookr compatibility regression, not a separate native observation.

country.effect: Editable metadata. India uses its State catalog; UK and the unchanged United Kingdom alias use the four known Region suggestions. Master-enabled servers expose genuine State catalogs for every country, initially Not Applicable plus explicitly created custom entries outside known regional catalogs. Unmatched Enter/Tab stays in the field; whole-form save preserves raw metadata. Older servers retain plain free-text entry outside the static India/UK catalogs. The app-wide master expansion is original Bookr behavior, not a claim of native global catalog parity.

keyboard.Enter or Tab: Choose the genuine highlighted catalog row and advance to Pincode or Country; no matches keeps input and focus unchanged
keyboard.ArrowUp or ArrowDown: Move the highlight without changing the input; clamp at the list boundary
keyboard.Escape with text: Clear the search and keep the suggestions available
keyboard.Escape without text: Close suggestions and delegate the same key to existing company exit/dirty confirmation. Keep the blank draft; No or dialog Escape cancels exit without restoring the old value
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Close suggestions and preserve normal backward focus
keyboard.Ctrl+A: Preserve the raw field and invoke existing company save once; never replace it with a highlighted partial match

compatibility: Retain existing unknown saved state strings
Retain unmatched entered text through the existing free-text contract; this does not create a geographic master
Leaving the field without choosing a suggestion must not silently replace entered text
Optional blank text remains compatible with existing company storage

All countries retain exact raw metadata on whole-form save. Master-enabled servers require a genuine highlighted row for Enter/Tab selection; older servers retain plain free-text Enter navigation outside the static India/UK catalogs.
validation: No new geographic, postal, tax or country-validation rules
defaults: Keep existing company defaults; do not infer country-dependent accounting defaults
accountingEffect: None. Dates, currency, ledgers, vouchers, postings, bill allocations and outstanding balances remain unchanged.
implementation: Original reusable input-backed suggestion component with a separately tested pure behavior model

pureModel.scope: Filtering, selection, bounded movement, accepted-value focus and observed Escape action projection.
pureModel.buildTextChoices: Return ordered catalog-only rows matching the query and a preferred genuine index. Unknown opening and query text remain in the field and never become list options; unmatched fallback rows are excluded.
pureModel.moveHighlight: Clamp movement at the first and last row; no selection for an empty list.
pureModel.chooseDraftValue: Explicit acceptance uses a genuine selected row; whole-form save preserves all raw text, including unknown and blank metadata.
pureModel.nextCompanyAddressField: A substantive state and country advance to Pincode; otherwise Country.
pureModel.escapeTextChoice: A closed list delegates; an open list with text clears; an open empty list closes and delegates exit. Never return or restore the opening value.
pureModel.boundary: Observed creation cancellation is integrated with Bookr's existing original confirmation and saved-company compatibility; no new company configuration or accounting rule.
pureModel.filterCatalogRows: Shared case-insensitive substring filter preserves original catalog objects and order, reused by text, Group and Ledger pickers.
